English: Oak Sapling
A newly planted sacred oak sapling, tended by the tribe as a sign of hope and unity.
Wicker Fence
A simple enclosure of woven branches protects the sacred area, drawing the attention of the faithful.
Shrine Patch
Small earthen shrines and votive offerings surround the sapling, drawing more worshippers and fostering unity.
Blessed Oak
The sapling has grown into a sturdy young oak, now considered blessed by the clans priests and used for sacred rites.
Idol Pavilion
A roofed wooden pavilion now shelters wooden idols and the sacred oak, serving as a focus for communal rituals and offerings.
Sanctuary Circle
Sacred stones and timbers form a great circle around the oak, marking a powerful place of assembly, sacrifice, and tribal judgement.
Priests Hut
A dedicated hut for the clans priest is erected near the sanctuary, enabling more rituals, blessings, and spiritual guidance.
Ancestors Hall
A wooden hall for feasts and honoring the ancestors is built, deepening the tribes connection to its roots and each other.
High Oak Sanctuary
A grand sanctuary of decorated timber and sacred carvings stands around the now-mighty oak, central to all religious life.
Baltic Sacred Grove
The tribes holiest place: a vast, ancient grove of sacred oaks, site of clan councils, festivals, and great rites of unity.
